structured_output.mechanisms: Time is steps times per-step cost. Per-step cost grows with stage-2 and stage-3 widths, scales roughly linearly with batch size plus a ~15% fixed overhead, and has a small cutout surcharge. Low-resolution early steps cut the cost by about 30% of the compute they cover. Accuracy depends on the epoch budget, model width, label smoothing near 0.1 and lighter translation. Cutout, random flip and low-res downsampling each cost accuracy.
